title: Half a wavelength apart: quiet
caption: At 343 Hz, λ = 343/343 = 1 m. Your distances to the speakers differ by 0.5 m = λ/2, so the two waves arrive half a cycle apart and cancel: you hear a quiet spot.
alt: Two equal waves half a wavelength out of step, adding to a flat line.
description: λ = 1 m; path difference 0.5 m = ½λ, a phase difference of 180°.
The two waves arriving are equal and opposite at every moment, so they sum to zero.
A path difference of a whole number of wavelengths would give a loud spot.
